chunks: And with this chain of narration, it was said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
When you name your child Muhammad, honor him, make room for him in the gatherings, and do not give him a mean/displeased look.
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended etiquette for parents towards a child named Muhammad according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this hadith to highlight the spiritual gravity of the Prophet's name, urging parents to cultivate an environment of dignity and affection for the child. This instruction reflects the Shia emphasis on *Adab* (etiquette) within the family, linking the child's social standing to the reverence due to the Prophet Muhammad (s) and his Ahl al-Bayt.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-29 According to the same documentation, God’s Prophet (S) said,
“Whenever you name your son Muhammad honor him, make room for him in meetings and do not give him mean looks.”
